key_highlights: ASX staged an $80 billion relief rally following the US midterms despite a late-week dip, closing higher overall as global energy prices slumped.
Department store giant David Jones collapsed into voluntary administration after eleventh-hour landlord negotiations failed, placing thousands of retail jobs and unsecured suppliers at risk.
Major divergence across ASX large-caps as NextDC surged on sustained AI infrastructure demand, while National Australia Bank dropped sharply, dampening financials.
Qantas announced targeted capacity reductions and fare increases to offset an impending $1 billion escalation in jet fuel expenditures.
RBA hawkish rhetoric regarding persistent excess demand and inflation contrasts with escalating housing price crash forecasts and reduced household borrowing power.

sectors.trend: Severe solvency stress culminating in David Jones entering voluntary administration with store closures and severe supplier payment freezes.
sectors.implications: Spillover headwinds across discretionary retailers and department store supply chains as household budget pressures and high interest rates constrain discretionary turnover.

sectors.trend: Sharp selling in major banks led by NAB's dive alongside intensifying mortgage borrowing capacity compression and residential default risks.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin headwinds and weakening credit demand as RBA's tight monetary posture elevates loan book vulnerability and credit risk repricing.

sectors.trend: Strong institutional buying in AI data infrastructure (NextDC soaring) despite broader restructuring and tech retrenchment evident at Canva.
sectors.implications: High dispersion within Australian tech; digital infrastructure and cloud assets attract capital while early-stage tech faces capital discipline.

sectors.trend: Buoyant gold exploration activity, active broker capital raisings, and steady exploration interest across critical minerals and base metals.
sectors.implications: Precious metals explorers and producers benefit from risk-off gold demand and equity financing liquidity, even as broader industrial metals remain cautious.

sectors.trend: Crude oil declines lower input costs broadly, but carrier-specific fuel bill surges force Qantas to hike fares and prune seat capacity.
sectors.implications: Aviation revenue management offsets input cost pressures via passenger yields, while upstream oil and gas producers face revenue dampening from declining crude.

sectors.trend: Landlord distress from major retail anchor insolvency (David Jones) coupled with deteriorating residential real estate price projections.
sectors.implications: Heightened tenant renegotiation risk and potential valuation markdowns for shopping centre REITs alongside slowing residential project development.

key_themes: Macroeconomic divergence between persistent RBA inflation concerns and emerging housing correction warnings.
Corporate restructuring and insolvency pressures accelerating across consumer-facing and retail sectors.
Capital reallocation toward mission-critical digital infrastructure and gold assets amidst broader index volatility.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Discretionary Retail and Supply Chain Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical retail equities; maintain defensive allocation to consumer staples and essential services.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn and Mortgage Asset Quality
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to highly leveraged domestic banks and residential developers; favor diversified global miners and healthcare.
Prioritize cash-generative businesses with low debt-to-equity ratios and robust pricing power.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation and Transportation Input Cost Shocks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor passenger yield durability and fuel hedge ratios in transport holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight AI data centre infrastructure operators
opportunities.rationale: Resilient secular demand and pricing power supported by hyperscaler expansion and post-midterms capital inflows.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective positioning in gold miners and liquid explorers
opportunities.rationale: Supportive capital raising environment and strong investor appetite driven by hedging against global policy uncertainty.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical exposure to aviation yield resilience
opportunities.rationale: Active capacity cuts and aggressive ticket price pass-through mitigate headline fuel cost escalation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight retail REITs with department store exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration threatens anchor tenancy lease renewals, income streams, and cap rates.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim banking sector overweight and hedge index exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB sharp drawdown, borrowing power cuts, and emerging mortgage stress signal downside risk for bank margins.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 performance as post-midterm momentum contends with banking sector weakness and retail defaults.
market_outlook.long_term: Moderate recovery anchored by commodity exports and digital infrastructure, tempered by consumer belt-tightening and housing correction risks.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate decisions
David Jones administration restructuring developments and creditor/landlord outcomes
Major bank margin guidance and asset quality reporting following NAB's drop
Global crude oil trajectory and iron ore export price stability
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate volatility post-US midterms
Australian quarterly CPI and household spending indices
Dwelling approval figures and housing auction clearance rates
Corporate debt refinancing spreads and insolvency rates
